market_summary: Overall Sentiment: Long-term mega-bullish (the “Golden Goose” AI cycle could last until 2070). Intermediate-term cautiously optimistic: the broad market breakout is powerful and demands respect. Short-term neutral on speculative growth: the damaged leaders need time to base, and new CAN SLIM-style leaders have yet to emerge in force. "We need a couple non-recovery bounce-type stocks to go" (Roppel). The S&P 500’s action is undeniably strong; waiting for the Nasdaq and SMH to confirm with a follow-through day is the prudent course for growth-stock exposure.
